info.title: rsna-knee-bleg-s1-f01
info.subtitle: Severity-tuned ConvNeXt-S fold models (seed 1, folds 0+1), RSNA Knee 2026
info.description:
# RSNA Knee 2026: B-leg fold models, seed 1, folds 0 and 1

Two ConvNeXt-small study-level models for the 12 knee findings, produced by warm-starting the
public R6 fold models (`heliosli/rsna-knee-r6-frozen-fe055406`, V1, bundle `fe055406fad6a12f`)
and fine-tuning them for 2 epochs on gold-calibrated soft targets
(`rsna-knee-labels-soft-v2`). Seed 1 differs from seed 0 only in the sampling and augmentation
streams (same initialisation). Companion datasets: `rsna-knee-bleg-s0-f01`, `rsna-knee-bleg-s0-f23`.

## Training recipe
- Trainer: heliosli's `compact_train.py` v9.8 (embedded in the public 0.958 blend notebook),
  patched for Kaggle T4s: fp16 autocast + GradScaler in place of bf16, and a JPEG-backed row
  store in place of the uint8 memmap (Kaggle scratch is ~73 GB).
- Pixel cache: 3,383 studies (all 58 gold + 3,325 pool), rendered through the public inference
  path (`compact_infer.CStudies`: native → geometry → SKM-TEA anchors → v4 views), size 384,
  JPEG q90, 56 GB.
- Arm `E_prior` (BCE on `<Finding>|prior`), `--warm-start` from R6 with LR × 0.5, 2 epochs,
  batch 4 × 32 windows, crop 352, grad checkpointing, state/extent/spatial/syn-decomp heads kept
  (state targets blank, so the state loss is 0), `--seed-base 1`. One fold per T4.
- Hash folds (sha1 of StudyInstanceUID mod 4): fold k model never saw fold k's studies.

## Validation (58 expert-labeled studies, single fold model each)
| fold | gold macro AUC |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0.912 |
| 1 | 0.923 |
Strong: ACL 0.98–0.99, Medial OA 0.97–0.98, Medial Meniscus 0.97–0.98, Baker's 0.92–0.97.
Weak (low report signal): Lateral OA 0.85, Synovitis 0.86–0.87, PF OA 0.86–0.87, Effusion 0.86–0.90.

## Intended use
Soup the fold models per seed (weight average; they share one initialisation) and score them as
a second model group next to the R6 recipe at inference (`compact_infer.py --models2`).
